findings.title: Unsynced financial data is erased by a successful cloud refresh
findings.detail: Full-payload IndexedDB queue, guarded cloud merge, restart persistence and review UI verified. Cold offline startup, eviction/device loss and complete multi-device lifecycle coverage remain.

findings.title: Concurrent retries can persist several entities for one mutation ID
findings.detail: Per-user transaction lock, canonical request-bound receipt and original-response replay pass both 24-request concurrency cases on four PHP workers. Production load and every crash point remain untested.

findings.title: Rejected sync batches leave partial financial writes
findings.detail: Rejected sync and batch PATCH roll back source/effects/audit. Malformed rows and final reference graphs are checked. Imports remain explicitly per-row partial, not a full restore transaction.

findings.title: Stale sync data resurrects soft-deleted records
findings.detail: Versioned queued patches, changed-row sync preconditions and hard-delete tombstones pass stale-write regressions. Legacy versionless direct PATCH/DELETE and some batch/admin preconditions remain.

findings.title: Collection hard-delete leaves posted SQL ledger events
findings.detail: Collection hard-delete removes active effects, reverses source events and retains authoritative audit/tombstones in the same transaction. Historical orphan cleanup was not run.
